PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.1/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.1/ref#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?point ?tsid ?pclass WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone .
  ?zone rdfs:label "Perimeter_bot_ZN_2" .
  ?point brick:hasLocation ?zone .
  ?point ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
}

PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.1/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.1/ref#>
SELECT ?point ?pclass ?tsid WHERE {
  ?point a brick:OccupancySensor .
  ?point brick:hasLocation ?zone .
  ?point ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
}

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?point ?pclass ?tsid WHERE {
  ?zone rdfs:label "Perimeter_bot_ZN_2" .
  ?point brick:hasLocation ?zone .
  ?point ?pclass ?o .
  ?point ref:hasExternalReference ?ref .
  ?ref ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
}

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?point ?pclass WHERE {
  ?zone rdfs:label "Perimeter_bot_ZN_2" .
  ?point brick:hasLocation ?zone .
  ?point ?pclass ?o .
}

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?z (STR(?z) AS ?uri) ?lab WHERE { ?z ?p ?v . ?z rdfs:label ?lab } LIMIT 100

import csv
target='fdc5144e-8b59-5964-9eb1-f235f6e57fb3'
vals=[]
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        if row['timeseries_id']!=target: continue
        ts=row['timestamp']
        if ts.startswith('2018-10-23'):
            h=int(ts[11:13])
            if 8<=h<=18:
                vals.append((ts,float(row['value'])))
vals.sort()
print(len(vals))
print(vals)
mean=sum(v for _,v in vals)/len(vals)
print('mean',mean)
